say:3:1423349001:1.text: Florabelle! I can't believe it's really you! What a surprise!
say:3:1423349001:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔！真想不到，远道而来的客人竟然是你！

say:4:1423349002:1.text: It's so good to see you again!
say:4:1423349002:1.source_cn: 能再次见到你真是太高兴了！

say:5:1423349003:1.text: Magister, Chippy, and Hammie! What a joy to reunite with you.
say:5:1423349003:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，满满和漫漫！能再次见到你们，是我的幸运。
say:5:1423349003:1.male: Magister, Chippy, and Hammie! What a joy to reunite with you.
say:5:1423349003:1.female: Magister, Chippy, and Hammie! What a joy to reunite with you.

say:6:1423349004:1.text: But Florabelle, what brings you to Sal'thorin? Weren't you teaching at Jade Lake Academy?
say:6:1423349004:1.source_cn: 可是芙拉贝尔你怎么会来萨洛克兰呢？你不在翡湖学院上课了吗？

say:7:1423349005:1.text: Classes just ended for the semester, so I'm on a short break.
say:7:1423349005:1.source_cn: 最近刚好翡湖学院一学期的课程结束，进入了短暂的假期。

say:8:1423349006:1.text: Eironn wrote to me about everything that's happened here—the past from two thousand years ago, Misarte's curse, the exiled Wilders living underground...
say:8:1423349006:1.source_cn: 埃隆写信告诉了我们萨洛克兰发生的事，两千年前的过去，弥...

say:9:1423349007:1.text: And the wonderful news that the curse has been lifted.
say:9:1423349007:1.source_cn: 还有此处诅咒已经被解除这让人欣慰的消息。

say:10:1423349008:1.text: So I made Sal'thorin our destination for a learning journey with the Bulbsprites.
say:10:1423349008:1.source_cn: 于是，我就把萨洛克兰作为目的地，带着花灵们外出游学啦。

choice_prompt:11:1423349008.text: So I made Sal'thorin our destination for a learning journey with the Bulbsprites.
choice_prompt:11:1423349008.source_cn: 于是，我就把萨洛克兰作为目的地，带着花灵们外出游学啦。

say:12:1423349009:1.text: Exactly. Essail is part of the Wilder line, but their history has been hidden or forgotten for ages.
say:12:1423349009:1.source_cn: 正是如此。艾塞勒是绿裔分支的一部分，但长久以来他们的存...

say:13:1423349010:1.text: As a teacher, I believe it's important to rediscover and pass on their stories.
say:13:1423349010:1.source_cn: 我认为重新了解、教授、传承这些被遗忘的历史，是作为老师...

say:14:1423349011:1.text: Plus, I heard there's a unique underground ecosystem here, and the ruins of the Ironheart Dominion.
say:14:1423349011:1.source_cn: 而且我听说这里还有特殊的地底自然生态和钢心帝国的遗迹。

say:15:1423349012:1.text: Where else can you find so much to learn and experience in one place, right?
say:15:1423349012:1.source_cn: 一处地点同时汇集了如此丰富的知识与体验……不会有比这里...

say:17:1423349014:1.text: Florabelle, if you'd like a tour, we'd be happy to be your guides!
say:17:1423349014:1.source_cn: 芙拉贝尔，如果你想参观萨洛克兰的话，我们可以做你的向导哦！

say:18:1423349015:1.text: Magister knows the area well and has met lots of Essail too!
say:18:1423349015:1.source_cn: 主人已经对这里很熟悉了，还认识很多艾塞勒呢！
say:18:1423349015:1.male: Magister knows the area well and has met lots of Essail too!
say:18:1423349015:1.female: Magister knows the area well and has met lots of Essail too!

say:19:1423349016:1.text: In that case, Magister, do you know anyone here with deep knowledge of Sal'thorin's history, customs, and traditions? I'd love to ask them a few questions.
say:19:1423349016:1.source_cn: 既然如此，梅林大人是否认识对萨洛克兰的历史、习俗、礼仪...
say:19:1423349016:1.male: In that case, Magister, do you know anyone here with deep knowledge of Sal'thorin's history, customs, and traditions? I'd love to ask them a few questions.
say:19:1423349016:1.female: In that case, Magister, do you know anyone here with deep knowledge of Sal'thorin's history, customs, and traditions? I'd love to ask them a few questions.

say:20:1423349017:1.text: History, customs, traditions... Hmm, it has to be someone who's really well-read...
say:20:1423349017:1.source_cn: 历史、习俗、礼仪……应该是对书本上的知识十分了解的人吧……

choice_prompt:21:1423349017.text: History, customs, traditions... Hmm, it has to be someone who's really well-read...
choice_prompt:21:1423349017.source_cn: 历史、习俗、礼仪……应该是对书本上的知识十分了解的人吧……

say:22:1423349018:1.text: Right! She used to be a priestess. She should know all about that stuff!
say:22:1423349018:1.source_cn: 对呀！欧罗娜之前当过祭司，应该会对这些知识有所了解！

say:23:1423349019:1.text: Let's head to the Lunaris Altar and see if she's around.
say:23:1423349019:1.source_cn: 我们去银月祭庭附近找找她？

say:24:1423349020:1.text: Thank you all. I can't wait to meet this Orlana you speak so highly of.
say:24:1423349020:1.source_cn: 感谢你们，我迫不及待要与你们口中的欧罗娜见面了。

choice:11:0:1.source_cn: 把萨洛克兰作为目的地？
